articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Ex-Trump crypto adviser profited after helping pass stablecoin bill: WSJ
articles.description: The Wall Street Journal reported that a company co-founded by Bo Hines benefited from the passage of the GENIUS stablecoin bill.

articles.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
articles.description: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.

articles.title: Mastercard brings stablecoin balances into traditional banking and card payments
articles.description: The launch of Global Money Platform marks Mastercard’s first major integration with BVNK since its August acquisition, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first companies to adopt the platform.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips under $80K after US PPI gains most in four years
articles.description: BTC buyers attempted to defend $80,000 support after September US producer inflation overshot expectations by 100 basis points for the largest monthly gain since March 2022

articles.title: Russia to ban direct peer-to-peer crypto trades starting July 2027
articles.description: Russia plans to ban direct P2P crypto trades from July 1, 2027, while separate rules already prohibit transfers from digital accounts to self-custody wallets.

articles.title: Nasdaq-listed Tron sets up $200M ATM share offering to fuel TRX acquisitions
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed treasury company holds about $237 million in TRX tokens and plans to raise additional capital to fund its purchases, alongside its daily accumulation.

articles.title: Can the SEC and CFTC’s pro-crypto rules be overturned? Legal opinion
articles.description: The SEC and the CFTC have issued a raft of pro-crypto rules recently. But will the rules hold up in court, and can they be easily rolled back by the “anti-crypto army”?

articles.title: HEX token sellers erase $160M following reports of founder Richard Schueler arrest
articles.description: The HEX token’s price declined by 30% following local media reports of the Istanbul arrest of founder Richard Schueler, nearly two years after Interpol issued a “Red Notice.”

articles.title: Ledger’s answer to wallet tampering costs $849 and ships next year
articles.description: Ledger’s new Atom combines crypto wallet security with everyday apps and is expected to ship in summer 2027 as the company investigates tampered wallets sold in Asia.

articles.title: White House crypto council chief Patrick Witt steps down
articles.description: Witt’s departure leaves a leadership gap at the White House Crypto Council and marks the fourth high-profile exit from the advisory group.

articles.title: Starknet opens vote on potential Ethereum L2 exit over quantum risks
articles.description: Starknet is asking STRK holders whether to explore becoming an independent layer-1 blockchain to reduce its dependence on Ethereum’s quantum-security upgrade timeline.

articles.title: Bitget, Liquid exploits push Q3 crypto hacks toward $1.2B
articles.description: Compromised suppliers, developer tools and infrastructure components outside security audits drove about 77% of the quarter’s total losses, according to Hacken.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips to $80.1K as KOSPI closes at its lowest since April
articles.description: Bitcoin price action continued to see contagion from a Korean tech sell-off after the KOSPI Index fell 7.5% on Thursday.

articles.title: Thailand crypto ETFs may see slow start despite new rules: CoinShares
articles.description: Thailand’s new Bitcoin and Ether ETF rules take effect Friday, but CoinShares expects modest initial inflows as existing investment options compete for demand.

articles.title: Babylon advances native Bitcoin lending proposal on Aave V4
articles.description: Babylon’s proposal to bring native Bitcoin collateral to Aave V4 has entered a new governance stage, but further votes and security reviews remain before launch.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $261M as XRP funds buck weekly outflow trend
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $151 million in net outflows since Monday, after investors withdrew $681 million the previous week.

articles.title: South Korea plans cybersecurity overhaul after attacks hit banks, crypto firms
articles.description: South Korea is proposing tougher cybersecurity assessments after a review identified security deficiencies at 130 financial firms.

articles.title: Australia seeks feedback on crypto platform rules ahead of 2027 rollout
articles.description: The consultation follows Parliament’s passage of digital asset legislation in April, with Australia’s securities regulator now proposing capital, custody and trading standards for crypto platforms.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners plunge up to 13% in Wall Street’s worst selloff since July
articles.description: TeraWulf, Core Scientific, Cipher Mining and IREN each lost more than 12% as hotter inflation hit AI infrastructure companies.

articles.title: VanEck seeks to withdraw application for Lido staked Ether ETF
articles.description: VanEck initially filed an S-1 registration statement for the exchange-traded fund in October last year.

articles.title: Polygon gains US payments licenses after closing Coinme deal
articles.description: The deal gives Polygon access to 37 money transmitter licenses and 11 state exemptions.

articles.title: Organizations join forces to fight Illinois crypto tax, after 6-month pause
articles.description: Illinois officials already agreed to delay implementation of a 0.2% tax on crypto assets, but industry-aligned organizations are pushing for summary judgment on the merits.

articles.title: EU authority classifies Circle’s USDC as ‘significant’ under MiCA
articles.description: The second-largest stablecoin by market cap will be overseen by French and EU authorities under its classification as a “significant e-money token.“

articles.title: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions
articles.description: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized 112 servers and shut down 241 websites linked to investment scams that targeted Russian-speaking Americans.

articles.title: OCC report finds debanking efforts tied to crypto activities
articles.description: The report from the US banking regulator did not include specific examples of debanking related to crypto, but mentioned it alongside ties to oil, gas and firearms.

articles.title: Standard Chartered pushes $2T stablecoin forecast to 2030 as transaction volumes grow
articles.description: The bank identified four distinct stablecoin markets, with USDC leading payments and AI transactions as competition intensifies over reserve yields.

articles.title: Bitcoin price dips below $82K as high oil prices spike US CPI inflation
articles.description: Bitcoin fell below $82,000 while bond yields targeted new 24-year highs on the back of hot US CPI inflation.

articles.title: ‘Bunker mode’ won’t protect your crypto, critics say
articles.description: Even if Justin Drake’s prediction that AI could break cryptography proves correct, critics say “bunker mode” is an impractical suggestion that’s unlikely to protect your crypto.

articles.title: Canada crypto remittances to Asian countries surge 141% to $2.36B: Chainalysis
articles.description: Remittance-sized crypto transfers from Canada to three Asian countries reached $2.36 billion, while transfers to the Philippines alone rose 28% to $61 million.
